summaryJa: MISREP 4871281。コールサイン14a（発信元482 ATKS、任務種別AREC）はOKAS発着でNAVCENT支援のISR任務を実施（作戦海域：アラビア湾、ホルムズ海峡、オマーン湾）。現地待機は0117Z開始、1835Zに任務解除、現地離脱021922Z、着陸021953Z／エンジン停止022003Z。総任務時間21時間4分、現地総滞在20時間22分。主要センサーANDAS4。FMVはDGS-1が解析。事前調整は24時間前にNAVCENTと実施し「満足」。気象は濃い靄でIMINT解析に制約。観測事項：1244Z/1344Zにアブムサ島滑走路で航空機（評価：ATR 72-500）を観測、1657Zにブシェル造船所付近で係留中の標的らしき船舶を観測、1829ZにUAPを1件観測。0727Z、0854Z、1122Z、1236Z、1315Zにガードコールを受信し全て標準応答で任務に影響なし。IMINT稼働17.3時間、IMINT課題遂行15.3時間。任務成果は機上観測と映像提供（課題数合計4、うち3件は14aによる遂行）。
summaryEn: MISREP 4871281. Aircraft callsign 14a (originator 482 ATKS) conducted an AREC ISR mission from OKAS supporting NAVCENT in the Arabian Gulf, Strait of Hormuz, and Gulf of Oman. On-station from 0117Z, cleared off task at 1835Z, off-station 021922Z, landed 021953Z (engine shutdown 022003Z). Total mission time 21:04; total time on station 20:22. Primary sensor ANDAS4; FMV exploited by DGS-1. Precoord with NAVCENT 24 hours prior was satisfactory. Heavy haze limited IMINT analysis. Observations: aircraft on Abu Musa runway at 1244Z/1344Z (assessed ATR 72-500), a possible target vessel moored at Bushehr shipyard at 1657Z, and one UAP observed at 1829Z. Guard calls received at 0727Z, 0854Z, 1122Z, 1236Z, and 1315Z; all met with standard responses and caused no mission impact. IMINT hours 17.3; IMINT tasking prosecuted 15.3 hours. Mission produced onboard observations and imagery (total taskings prosecuted: 4; 3 executed by 14a).
